visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with a sleek short bob haircut and prominent silver hoop earrings is positioned in the center for a medium close-up shot. She wears a dark navy pinstriped cardigan with a subtle texture over a sheer black mesh top. Below her, an inset graphic appears showing a model in beige outdoor gear. The setting is a brightly lit indoor living room with cream-colored walls and a hint of a ceiling lamp. (2) The scene cuts to a wider medium shot as she stands and gestures toward her torso to highlight the cardigan's fabric. A new inset graphic displays a male model in a purple garment. She uses expressive hand movements, including pointing and waving, while maintaining direct eye contact with the camera. The background reveals a grey fabric sofa and a minimalist interior design. (3) A close-up shot focuses on her right hand, adorned with gold rings, pointing to a meticulously embroidered black butterfly logo on the purple fabric. The lighting is soft and directional, accentuating the texture of the material and the sheen of her jewelry. The camera remains static during this detailed inspection. (4) The woman transitions into a dark purple, high-pile fleece jacket. She faces the camera, demonstrating the functionality of the front zipper and the adjustable elastic drawstrings at the waist. An inset graphic shows a female model in the same attire. The indoor lighting remains bright, casting soft shadows on the background wall. (5) She holds up a pair of thick, charcoal grey sweatpants for the camera's inspection before switching to a full-body shot. She wears the pants and turns to provide side and rear views, checking the fit. The camera captures her full silhouette against the backdrop of the living room, which includes a wooden coffee table and a neutral rug. (6) A screen recording of the "needles.jp" Instagram account is displayed, showing a collection of stylized fashion photography in a grid format. The interface is clean, with the brand name visible at the top. The visual pace is static as the screen scrolls briefly through the images. (7) Returning to the original medium close-up, the woman in the navy cardigan speaks directly to the audience, summarizing her final recommendations. She uses open hand gestures and thoughtful facial expressions. The lighting and background are consistent with the opening phase, providing a sense of narrative closure.
